description: Head-movement mini-game G19, Group D (fun finale): traffic-light game. 10 fixed rounds: green = turn to the cued direction past 27 degrees within 4 seconds, red = freeze still (total angular change under 5 degrees) for 3 seconds, moving on red fails at once. Return to center gates every next round. Dual-axis start calibration (look down, turn left) learns both signs. Temple tap starts and replays; no camera, no mic/ASR.
name: traffic-light
